q1: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2: SELECT EMAIL FROM (SELECT DISTINCT EMAIL, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL) AS E WHERE CNT>1
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT EMAIL FROM (SELECT DISTINCT EMAIL, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL) AS E WHERE CNT>1
explanation: Both Q1 and Q2 are designed to find emails that are associated with more than one person in the PERSON table. They achieve this by grouping the records by email and then filtering out the emails that have a count greater than 1.
